purpose: Run a new three-arm, three-seed trajectory under the unchanged v0.8N training treatment and recipe, with dense checkpoints in optimizer steps 81-120.

v08n_training_seal.role: lineage reference only; no old head is a P initialization

v08o_result_seal.role: prospective question rationale only; no checkpoint or evaluation row is reused

treatments.primary_question: On a fresh held-out panel, how do sham locality, matched-neutral locality, and fact-response coordinates evolve over optimizer steps 81-120, and how do the three training treatments differ in timing or form?
treatments.arm_difference_only: auxiliary_source_role and its already-sealed source feature pointer
treatments.B-DUP: each anchor receives its exact anchor target again
treatments.B-MATCHED: the prospectively radius-matched neutral training view receives the anchor target
treatments.B-SHAM: the certified sham training view receives the anchor target

training_inputs.reuse_rule: Reuse only these exact sealed training-side inputs after recomputing and matching their hashes. Do not load the E1 panel, E1 candidate vectors, E1 joins, E1 targets, or E1 predictions as P inputs.
training_inputs.new_schedule: Materialize a P-specific common schedule from the frozen occurrence manifest and the seeds below. The schedule must be hashed and independently checked before any P head initialization; the old v0.8N schedule hash is not reused.

model_and_head.head: CompatibilityHead(2048, mlp, 128)
model_and_head.head_inputs: raw float32 frozen state and candidate features; no normalization, centering, scaling, or covariance transform
model_and_head.candidate_masks: all four true; no padding candidates
model_and_head.candidate_order_transform: reverse candidate indices and target values together, exactly as the frozen fast_tensor_batch path

loss.per_event: categorical cross-entropy plus 0.25 times multiclass Brier score
loss.reduction: arithmetic mean over all active primary and auxiliary events in the optimizer step

schedule.source_order: sorted group_id order from the common primary occurrence manifest
schedule.batching: consume the frozen P schedule directly; no runtime shuffle, sampler, or drop_last
schedule.auxiliary_placement: append one auxiliary event for each scheduled anchor to that same optimizer batch in the frozen slot order
schedule.forward_order: primary rows first, followed by auxiliary events in scheduled anchor-slot order

seed_set.derivation: SHA-256(UTF-8('jev-information-density-v08p-run-v01/optimizer-seed/{index}')); interpret the first four digest bytes as unsigned little-endian u32; indices 0, 1, 2
seed_set.pairing: one seed-initialized head template per seed, byte-identical across the three arms; reset Python, Torch CPU, and CUDA RNG streams to the seed for each run

checkpoint_payload: seed, arm, epoch, global_step, schedule hash, last committed occurrence index
checkpoint_policy.write_rule: atomic checkpoint write; hash only after durable completion; no evaluation process may read before the complete tree is sealed

restart_policy.infrastructure_failure: preserve failed-attempt artifacts; resume only from the last fully validated per-step checkpoint for that same seed and arm, including optimizer and RNG state
restart_policy.no_checkpoint_or_invalid_checkpoint: restart that seed-arm from its paired initial template at step zero only if the run has no committed optimizer step; otherwise stop for review
restart_policy.contract_hash_mismatch_or_nonfinite_stat: halt the whole experiment; not an infrastructure retry
restart_policy.runtime_basis: Torch deterministic algorithms remain disabled as in the sealed v0.8N runtime; record that CUDA execution may not be bitwise reproducible across a resumed boundary

runtime_environment.mismatch_disposition: ABORT_BEFORE_HEAD_INITIALIZATION; no software, hardware, precision, or deterministic-mode substitution

implementation_gate.checkpoint_cadence_delta: instrumentation-only: persist every epoch-3 optimizer step and its optimizer/RNG continuation state; no change to event order, loss, optimizer, or update arithmetic
implementation_gate.p_specific_runner: not yet materialized; before separate training authorization, bind its exact source hash and tests proving event/update parity against the frozen reference semantics
required_pretraining_tests: three arm manifests share the exact common primary occurrence stream
per-seed initial head hashes are identical across all three arms
per-epoch primary and auxiliary event schedules are identical across arms
the same treatment payload is the only arm-specific event field
every step-81..120 checkpoint round-trips model, optimizer, and RNG state
resume from a synthetic committed checkpoint matches uninterrupted deterministic fixture updates
checkpoint instrumentation does not change loss/update arithmetic
trainer filesystem scope denies every P-panel and E1 path
